spans.s:
Apī.--Ludwig finds an apī whose sons are described as not performing sacrifice (a-yajña-sāc) and as breakers of the law of mitra-varuṇa in the Rigveda. Roth and Grassmann take the expression used (apyaḥ putrāḥ) as referring to the sons of the waters.
Foot notes Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 158, 159.
vi. 67, 9.
St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v., apya.
